crewNotes.text: General Thai traveller allowances; operating crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with Thai Customs. Compiled from the cited Thai Customs guidance and pending final authority review.

rules.text: Arriving travellers may bring in no more than 1 litre of alcoholic beverage duty-free.

declarationRequirements.text: Personal belongings up to a total value of THB 20,000 are exempt from duty (excluding prohibited/restricted items and food); higher-value goods must be declared.

rules.text: Arriving travellers may bring in no more than 200 cigarettes, or 250g of tobacco, or 250g of all types combined, duty-free.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
